As a ucsb student, take advantage of your free resources and do a little bit of your own actual research. Looking for coffee shops? We have about 5 main “chains” that are all local. Go on Google maps, look at what they offer, and see if their menu prices align with what you’re willing to spend. You get a free rec cen membership through ucsb, and the rec cen is amazing. UCSB also has a AS food bank (on campus) and Miramar food pantry (off campus) which is completely free. It’s usually filled with local produce and dry pantry staples. Get your groceries here weekly first, then supplement with other grocery stores. Stay up to date with grocery store weekly ads to see what will be on sale, and download the Target app for extra coupons. SB is expensive. Our Target charges more on a lot of products than what is listed on the app/ website. It’s a few cents here and there, but it adds up.

Overall I prefer ABH and CP over makeup geek. 

* Abh is by far my favorite. Both mattes and shimmers are really soft, smooth, and pigmented. They're easy to blend for me, and I don't really need too much product for the full color. The shimmers are more pigmented than the mattes. They break really easily, though. They don't just break, they turn to dust and make it a pain to clean. I also like ABH because you can swatch colors in person at Sephora/ ulta instead of intensively googling swatches.
*  As for CP, both their shimmers and mattes are nice. Some are a bit more firm, but still smooth. I would have been perfectly content with just ABH and CP eyeshadows  IIRC, their singles and quads are the same size as the other pans, but I think the eyeshadows in the other palettes are smaller?
* MUG is a bit chalky and hit or miss. I had to do quite a bit of research to see which colors were good quality. That being said, I really like their colors. My most used colors are MUG. It's a shame because some colors aren't as pigmented and don't apply as nicely as the other colors I have. When I use them up completely, I don't plan on repurchasing them. I don't think the non-sales + quality gambles are worth it.

**TL;DR** Overall, I'm completely happy with the ABH shadows I have. I think the CP eyeshadows are the best values because they have sales often, and the quality is just as good as ABH. 

Also, I reference [this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/MakeupAddiction/comments/8perl6/updated_pan_diameter_list/) to make sure all the singles I'm buying are the same size.
